engine_name: ChainSentinel Recovery Planning & Resilience-Aware Optimization Engine

capacity_budget.budget_description: Normalized Recovery Capacity Units (RCUs) representing carrier expediting quotas and logistics bandwidth.

candidate_plans.name: Baseline (No Intervention)
candidate_plans.description: Zero recovery resource expenditure; all orders absorb baseline disruption delay. Reference benchmark.

candidate_plans.name: Priority-First Recovery
candidate_plans.description: Greedy capacity allocation in ascending Phase 9 priority rank order (Ranks 1 to K).

candidate_plans.name: Financial Exposure First
candidate_plans.description: Greedy capacity allocation maximizing protected commercial revenue exposure.

candidate_plans.name: Composite Vulnerability First
candidate_plans.description: Greedy capacity allocation prioritizing highest composite Phase 9 risk scores.

candidate_plans.name: Mode Urgency & Buffer First
candidate_plans.description: Greedy allocation prioritizing expedited shipping modes and shortest scheduled transit buffers.

candidate_plans.name: Bounded Knapsack Hybrid
candidate_plans.description: Greedy bounded knapsack maximizing (Risk Score * Revenue Exposure) / RCU cost ratio.

counterfactual_stress_scenarios.name: Nominal Baseline
counterfactual_stress_scenarios.description: Original Phase 8 disruption footprint (96 hrs port delay estimate, 100% terminal capacity drop).

counterfactual_stress_scenarios.name: Extended Disruption (+48 hrs)
counterfactual_stress_scenarios.description: Port closure extended from 96 to 144 hours. Increased transit buffer exhaustion.

counterfactual_stress_scenarios.name: Secondary Carrier Crunch (-40% Expedite)
counterfactual_stress_scenarios.description: Regional air/express cargo capacity constrained by 40%, degrading expediting success rate.

counterfactual_stress_scenarios.name: Recovery Budget Contraction (-25% RCU)
counterfactual_stress_scenarios.description: Emergency fiscal austerity reduces available recovery capacity budget by 25%.

counterfactual_stress_scenarios.name: Compound Cascading Shock
counterfactual_stress_scenarios.description: Simultaneous port delay extension (+48h), carrier bottleneck (-30%), and regional demand surge (+15%).

academic_assumptions: Recovery actions represent simulated decision-support interventions, not physical logistics execution.
Recovery Capacity Units (RCUs) parameterize finite logistics expedite capacity, not monetary currency.
Counterfactual stress scenarios are parameterized stress tests, not probabilistic forecasts.
Canceled and fraudulent orders are permanently disqualified from recovery capacity allocation.
